title: Český Krumlov Castle
source: Retained exact-QID enclosure way797155316, current standard viewer building polygons with courtyard holes, named Cloak Bridge path and two inspected exterior pictures.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate correspondence of upper palace/two courtyards, lower Hradek/tower, theater and castle service ranges; nearby town buildings and overlapping building-part overlays are excluded.
axis: Native +X east-northeast along the compound toward the lower castle and decorated tower; +Z south-southeast toward the river-facing palace and tower facade. Theater/covered bridge lie to negativeX.

orientationControl.basis: Mapped decorated tower at eastern/lower end and theater/covered bridge at western end fix the signed long axis; the two oblique pictures distinguish river-facing and northern courtyard sides.

bridges.name: Plášťový most
bridges.scope: Named mapped crossing controls the bridge axis; short theater-end continuation and all story/arch profiles are photo-led estimates.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Retain mapped overall heights of54.5m tower,23m upper palace,11m theater and5–14m selected ranges. Untagged ranges use conservative exterior estimates. Court/bridge attachment levels are approximate against standard DEM and the pictures.
reconstruction.scope: Upper palace with both open courtyards, decorated lower tower and Hradek courtyard, selected castle service ranges, theater, western elevated gallery and stacked Cloak Bridge. Village, gardens, site trees, detailed interiors and painted fresco imagery excluded.
